proof_summary: Taking \(p=3\) and \(r=2\), direct evaluation gives \(a(9)-a(3)=2^3\cdot3^9\cdot17\cdot875491\), so its \(3\)-adic valuation is exactly \(9\) and it is not divisible by the formally required \(3^{12}\). Thus this counterexample refutes only the stronger formal modulus (which contains an extra factor \(3^3\)); it does not refute the intended modulus \(3^9\).
